dominant_breach: probate, intestacy, heirs-property title cloud, and forced-sale risk
fastest_washout: forced sale, disaster-aid exclusion, and unusable inherited property

intergenerational_transfer_gate.note: Inherited real property cannot count as usable wealth without title finality, financing access, disaster-aid eligibility, and partition protection.

probate_access_cost_timing.note: Estate administration friction can block modest assets from becoming usable wealth.

intestacy_title_finality.note: Intestacy and informal succession can leave fractional, unclear, or unrecorded interests that do not convert into usable household wealth.

heirs_property_partition_protection.note: UPHPA-style protections mitigate forced-sale risk but require adoption, notice, appraisal, buyout, and partition-in-kind implementation evidence. Rev0344 unused-source burn-down: World Bank women/land-rights evidence is now bound to heirs-property and land-title protection.

title_probate_finality.note: Heirs property creates a claim-finality failure: families may have nominal ownership but lack marketable title, program access, or financing. Rev0344 unused-source burn-down: World Bank land-rights material is now bound to the title-finality burden.

small_estate_administration_access.note: Small-estate and probate access must be scored by cost, time, legal help, language access, and whether title clears before tax sale, partition, disaster, or program threshold.

proof_debt: disaster, tax sale, and infrastructure vulnerability

gate_19_intergenerational_transfer.why: Comfort certification is blocked until the scoreboard proves claim conversion, notice, timing, legal aid or administrative capacity, vendor/report suppression where relevant, and subgroup outcomes at the actual threshold moment.

evidence_debt_register.question: title finality and program-access failure
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Collect parcel-level or program evidence linking heirs-property status to USDA/FEMA/credit/insurance/repair denial and delayed title resolution.

evidence_debt_register.question: UPHPA adoption and implementation
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Track state adoption, court use, appraisal quality, buyout uptake, partition-in-kind preference, and forced-sale outcomes.

evidence_debt_register.question: probate/small-estate cost and timing
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Measure whether low/modest estates can clear title without counsel costs that exceed the asset or threshold deadline.

evidence_debt_register.question: disaster, tax sale, and infrastructure vulnerability
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Pair title-cloud evidence with disaster aid, property-tax delinquency, repair grants, and infrastructure access outcomes.

validation_notes: rev0331 promotes this scoreboard from seed to active in the Gate 18/19 backlog-closure pass; certification remains blocked until operational claim conversion and outcome evidence are shown.
rev0344 binds formerly unused source S44 to `title_probate_finality` so active evidence lineage no longer leaves this source floating outside a case.
rev0344 binds formerly unused source S58 to `heirs_property_partition_protection` so active evidence lineage no longer leaves this source floating outside a case.
